{{Quote|When I was in Level Three, we used to come here for school retreat. See that island? We used to swim there every day. I love the water.|Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''Level Three''' was a ranking number among students on the planet Naboo, presumably as part of the planet's education system.

[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], when staying at [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] under the protection of then-Jedi Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] due to a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|threat against her life]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], recalled that at Level Three, she and her fellow students often stayed at the area during school retreat, recalling that she and the others frequently swam to a [[Amidala's Beach|nearby island]].
